newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tarkett Q1 profit down, sees full-year rise.
newsitem.headline: Tarkett Q1 profit down, sees full-year rise.

text.p: German floor coverings manufacturer Tarkett AG said on Tuesday it expected 1997 earnings to be above 1996 amid rising sales and stable raw materials prices in the last three quarters of 1997.
Tarkett said net profit in the first quarter fell to 10.6 million marks from 13.7 million in the year-earlier quarter. Sales in the period rose 8.3 percent to 359.1 million marks.
Earnings before writedowns on goodwill and before financial results fell to 28.5 million marks from 31.2 million, Tarkett said in a statement.
"In the coming three quarters we expect rising sales, stable raw materials and sales prices and therefore a higher profit than 1996," Tarkett said.
